title: Font Size
definition: Utilities for controlling the font size of an element.
simpleExplanation: Tailwind uses a t-shirt sizing scale. `text-xs` is tiny. `text-base` is normal paragraph text (16px). `text-2xl` is a heading. `text-9xl` is a gigantic hero billboard text.
realWorldExample: Creating a clean typographic hierarchy: `text-3xl` for the H1, `text-xl` for the H2, and `text-base` for the paragraphs.

basic: What is the default font size class in Tailwind (equal to 16px)?
intermediate: What second CSS property does Tailwind magically apply when you use a `text-*` size class?

answers.question: Second property?
answers.answer: Line height! Tailwind automatically pairs every font size with a mathematically perfect line-height (e.g., `text-sm` automatically gets a tighter line-height than `text-9xl`).

Subtitle

Normal readable paragraph text.
